business_summary: Zhaojin International Gold Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploration, mining, smelting, and sales of gold products in China. It is also involved in mineral resources, ore mining and processing, and mineral product sales business,  as well as develops and leases real estate properties. The company was formerly known as Zhongrun Resources Investment Corporation and change its name to Zhaojin International Gold Co., Ltd. in July 2025. Zhaojin International Gold Co., Ltd. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Jinan, China.
business_summary_ko: Zhaojin International Gold Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국에서 금 제품의 탐사, 채굴, 제련 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 또한 광물 자원, 광석 채굴 및 가공, 광물 제품 판매 사업에 참여하고 부동산을 개발 및 임대합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Zhongrun Resources Investment Corporation으로 알려졌으며 2025년 7월에 Zhaojin International Gold Co., Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. Zhaojin International Gold Co., Ltd.는 1988년에 설립되었으며 중국 지난에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
